info.name: UPONLY - UAT (working, with examples)
info.description:
Working UPONLY PA001 flow against the UAT sandbox.

Setup: set `username` and `password`, run **0. Get Token**, then run requests 1-10 in order. Dates and ApplicationNo are generated per run; ProposalNo / PolicyNo / rejectProposalNo are filled by test scripts. Credentials are intentionally not stored in this file.

**Saved examples**: folders `Plan 1`-`Plan 10` (PA001 sub 1 plans 1-5 with TTD, sub 2 plans 1-5 without TTD) each hold the 10-step flow with the real UAT response saved on every request. Examples were captured on 2026-10-01 against uponlyuat.

exec: // Unique ApplicationNo, refreshed every 30 min so re-runs do not collide.
if(!cv.get('token')&&pm.info.requestName.indexOf('Get Token')<0){console.warn('token is empty - run "0. Get Token" or set the token variable.');}
var t = pm.response.text(); var tok = null;
try { var j = JSON.parse(t); tok = j.access_token || j.token || j.ticket || j.Token || (j.data && (j.data.access_token || j.data.token || j.data.ticket)); } catch(e) { tok = t.trim(); }

request.description: Fetches a CAS ticket and stores it in `token`. Set `username` and `password` first (not stored in this collection). Re-run on 401.
